notes.title: Premium Pool Arena Out Now!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28342090/5e890b0f833edfef3f9314fb2f05f490b9068f7d.png[/img]

Premium Pool Arena is super fun, arcade style 8 ball pool game with extensive single and multiplayer options. The game has been designed specifically for desktop computers from the start. It does not take itself too seriously and it is not meant to be serious pool simulation. Instead it is a fun to play pool game that offers a vast selection of different cues with different properties. Experimenting with different cues keeps the gameplay interesting and it allows each player to find the best possible cue for their playstyle

The tournament system is completely reinvented compared to any other pool game. When participating in tournament the game will continue up to 10 wins or three losses, after which the tournament ends. After each game the reward price will rise. Another feature that makes the new tournament conventient is that it is not required to play during one session, but can be continued later.

The gamemodes in the game include single player against AI, speed mode, local multiplayer, online multiplayer and tournament system.
